description: Fetch SmartTest execution history for a testId (top 5 recent runs), an optional platform-rooted folder/file scope, or a scenario when scenarioId is set. Prefer testId when you have it from fetch-execution-report. Typically omit environment to avoid env scoping. Use branchName and scope.filePaths as for coverage. Optional platform (web|ios|android) and dimensionFilters narrow results. Set aggregate=true for suite timing stats (testCount, timedTestCount, sumSuccessMeanSecs, slowTestCount) instead of per-test history.
name: get-execution-history
title: Get Execution History
